reviews.snippet:
I had my ACL reconstruction surgery and my post-operative rehabilitation was guided by Dr. Siva Kalyan Reddy, Sports Physiotherapist, who works under Dr. Girisha B. A.

I am grateful for his patience, guidance and encouragement in my recovery. He explained every exercise clearly, ensured I performed them with the correct technique and motivated me to stay consistent with my rehabilitation.

Thanks to his structured physiotherapy, I achieved 110° knee flexion within 3 weeks after surgery, and my surgeon, Dr. Girisha B. A., is very pleased with my progress.

Dr. Siva Kalyan Reddy is approachable, supportive and genuinely cares about his patients' recovery. Thank you for making this difficult phase of my recovery easier and helping me through my recovery.

I highly recommend him to anyone recovering from a sports injury.
